text_block_list.text: One day, after winning numerous races together with Mejiro Ryan—

Told that she had ‘something important to discuss,’
I headed up to the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry to have kept you...
waiting for so long.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've finally made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There were times when I grew sick of my own uselessness. Times when I almost gave up, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, after overcoming countless hardships, I finally gained
the confidence to make it all the way here.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, the me of today... has earned the right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“The right to go on...
A   H O T   S P R I N G S   T R I P ! ! ! ! ! ! ! !”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
D-Did you forget?
Back during the New Year's raffle...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... could you hold onto
those tickets for me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Please! Until someday, when I can finally enjoy
free time and hobbies with genuine confidence!

"...Now I remember.
The way you brought it up was so overly dramatic that I didn't realize you were talking about a hot spring."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So, I thought about who to go with.
McQueen, Ines...
all sorts of folks...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if you're looking to reminisce about the Twinkle Series,
there's someone much more suited for that.
So..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Please take me on a hot springs trip!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? I feel like there was a romance movie
with a title like this a long time ago...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawa, that's not it at all!?
Even if it's a hot spring trip, please just take me
normally!! Just normally~~!!

I didn't quite understand what she meant by "normal,"
but I decided to accompany her anyway.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hauu~... Trainer,
I feel like I'm gonna cry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I was able to enjoy it... at my own pace.
Just normally, taking things real slow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It just felt natural to think, "I worked hard,
so it's okay to have this much fun."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring... I'm so glad I waited after all.
For the moment I could savor it as a reward like this.

After waiting so long, the emotion is all the more profound.
They seem deeply moved...
choice_data_list: There's still plenty of time to enjoy this.
There's still plenty of time to enjoy this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes! I want to enjoy this interval to the fullest!

I had a long talk with Mejiro Ryan,
who came over to hang out in my room. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, can I talk to you about something a bit weird?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, when I say "weird topic",
I don't mean anything inappropriate, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Earlier at the hot springs, as I took a good, long look
at my own body, it got me thinking...

...That was a plenty shady opening.
Still, let's hear the rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I feel like something's changed. With my body, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Back when I just lifted weights nonstop to forget my inferiority complex,
I was way more pumped up.
Looked a lot better, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now... to put it bluntly,
they've withered away.
I've lost that beefcake, gorilla-muscle look."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've gotten a bit leaner.
It's probably from running so much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, dancing. Maybe it's also because
I've become more conscious of dancing in front of people.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All these lifestyle changes
really do show up in your body, huh.
choice_data_list: Did I have more muscle before?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But no matter how much muscle I gained,
I still felt anxious. It couldn't protect my heart...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But right now, on the contrary, I feel like
my inner strength is showing in my body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
At last, I... have a body
that truly feels like my own...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I want to run. I want to dance.
Because I believe that very desire becomes my muscles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What kind of body do you like? I'm sure people
have all sorts of preferences. But still!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I love my body the way it is!
I love who I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: At the hot springs... that's what I thought...

To think she'd be pondering such things
at a hot spring she came to for fun.
Though I suppose that's just like her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... what did you think of what we just talked about?
If you have any thoughts on it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh, asking if I'm serious...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-Y-Yes, of course? I was thinking about it completely seriously, though. Huh? What?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-It can't be helped~! That's just my personality,
I can't change it so easily~~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You know that too, don't you, Trainer? Jeez~~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, fine! Call me serious all you want!
I'm just a party-pooper who can't stop overthinking
even on a reward vacation, okay?!
"Unusually, Mejiro Ryan was puffing out her cheeks."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm mad! But hey, you're the one
who chose me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you
for a long, long time to come!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, they're acting like newlyweds again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that's enough! I'm being serious!
Please take this seriously from here on out!
I'm being serious too!”

An inexplicable burst of anger. The eyes staring
straight at me wavered intensely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Listen to me.
I mean this... very seriously.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Then... never mind.
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond with Mejiro Ryan...
